coverage.inputConstraints: The first input line contains the only integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200) — the number of points in the given set. Next n lines contain the coordinates of the points written as "x y" (without the quotes) (|x|, |y| ≤ 1000), all coordinates are integers. The numbers in the line are separated by exactly one space. It is guaranteed that all points are different. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
